newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET PLANS TO SCRAP SUPERVISORY BOARD.
newsitem.headline: VALMET PLANS TO SCRAP SUPERVISORY BOARD.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its board would propose to the annual general meeting on April 10 that its supervisory board be abolished.
"The ministry of trade and industry has proposed to Valmet ... that the Valmet supervisory board be abolished," Valmet said.
"Valmet's board of directors is preparing a proposal on the matter, to be included in the annual general meeting agenda," it said.
The Finnish state owns 20.4 percent of Valmet's shares.

Metals an mining group Outokumpu Oy , in which the state owns 40 percent, earlier announced a similar proposal, also prompted by a letter from the ministry. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
